name: ecocode-profiler
description: A Hybrid Real-Time Energy Consumption and Carbon Estimation Extension for Python

ecocode.carbonIntensityFactor.description: Static regional grid carbon-intensity factor (gCO2e/kWh). Default is Sri Lanka (310).

ecocode.energyUnits.description: Units to display for energy consumption.

ecocode.suggestionModel.endpoint.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible code-model endpoint. Example for Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions. When empty, EcoCode uses its offline classifier.

ecocode.suggestionModel.name.description: Model name supplied to the configured code-model endpoint.

ecocode.suggestionModel.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for a local or self-hosted code model response. Larger local models may need longer on CPU.
